summary: Harden CI/CD workflows against injection, token abuse and supply-chain attacks.
intents: audit our github actions workflows for security problems
is it safe to use pull_request_target in this workflow
pin all third-party actions to commit shas
reduce the GITHUB_TOKEN permissions in our ci
stop secrets from leaking in build logs
harden the release pipeline that publishes to npm
not_for: setting up deploys to staging then production
prerequisites: which workflows publish, deploy or hold secrets

verify.description: No script injection or pwn-request patterns remain

verify: Every workflow has an explicit permissions block
Third-party actions are pinned to commit SHAs
